about: ev4's HTTP routes, read from ev4's pwa/worker.js, runapi.js, system.js, images.js, claude.js and planjob.js. Every route sits behind the one bearer token (worker.js checks it before any of them; a wrong token is 401). v5 answers each of these with 410 at cutover. Paths outside /api/ are the page's static files (Cloudflare assets), not routes here.
